title: kith-tslocal: whois cache has no eviction bound; can grow unbounded
description: LocalApiClient::whois() calls cache.retain(|_, (cached_at, _)| cached_at.elapsed() < WHOIS_CACHE_TTL) on every cache write. But if a node is never looked up again after being cached, the entry is never removed. In a large tailnet where many distinct addresses connect once-and-never-again (e.g. IP rotation, mobile nodes), the HashMap will grow monotonically. The retain() call is O(n) on every write but does not execute on cache hits. A long-running kithd on a busy network could accumulate thousands of stale entries. Fix: add an explicit max-entries cap (e.g. 1024) or switch to an LRU with bounded size.
